## Why `text_page.pdf` is 3 oversized pages

pypdf emits a blank line between pages, and `RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter`
splits on `"\n\n"` first. With pages under 4000 chars each page becomes exactly
one chunk and **overlap is never exercised**. The pages are deliberately sized
past `chunk_size` so the splitter must break *within* a page.

Observed with the pinned splitter (4000/200/len):

```
extracted: 16967 chars  →  6 chunks
lengths:   [3897, 1882, 3897, 1882, 3897, 1882]
overlaps:  [125, -2, 125, -2, 125]      # 125 within a page; -2 gap at page joins
```

Overlap appears only at intra-page breaks — it is **not** a property of every
boundary. Tests assert "at least one overlapping pair, and every overlap
≤ 200", which is the real behavior rather than an idealized one.
